description_en: Retrieves the details of a host account on a host managed by a Bastionhost instance, such as the protocol type and account name
description_zh: 获取指定主机账户详情
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-host-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-account-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHostAccount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where the host account that you want to query resides.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机账户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where the host account that you want to query resides.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机账户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host account that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的主机账户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_account_id
